note:
⛔ SNG-441. FOOTHILLS AND FOLK — Erik, 2026-08-15: 'Foothills are the FUNCTIONAL VERSION of the pole in many cases; in some cases the place that is APPROACHABLE and the ECONOMIC CENTER. They are also NOT strictly one pole per parent. We need balance, but foothills are most likely a BLEND of a primary domain with 1-2 of its neighbors.'
⚠️ THERE ARE 26 CANONICAL TRADITIONS — 24 ring poles on 12 axes, plus god_named and bargainers already carrying `pole: foothill`. I had been counting 31 by treating collection-keys as peoples.
_theRule:
⛔ A FOOTHILL IS NOT A LESSER TRADITION — IT IS A POLE MADE USABLE. The pole states the position absolutely; the foothill is what you can actually buy, hire, learn and live beside. ⚠️ AND THE EXISTING TWO PROVE THE BLEND CROSSES AXES rather than staying on neighbours:
   GOD-NAMED — 'borrowed grandeur worn slightly wrong; a man addressed by a name nobody in this valley can check.' ⛔ THAT IS SERAPHIC (angelic authority) BLENDED WITH VEILWRIGHT (falsehood). The functional version of divine authority is a borrowed one.
   BARGAINERS — 'a good table, a fair scale, an exit that is always shown to you and always costed.' ⛔ ABYSSAL (the named want, the struck term) BLENDED WITH VERIST (truth). The functional version of the bargain is an HONEST one, which is precisely why anyone sits down twice.
⚠️ SO THE PATTERN IS: TAKE THE POLE'S POWER AND ADD WHAT MAKES IT SURVIVABLE TO DEAL WITH.
⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15, REFINEMENT: 'It's likely that these foothills will have THREE DOMAINS, as each character does.' ⚠️ THAT IS THE RULE — a foothill is not a pole plus a qualifier, it is a THREE-DOMAIN BLEND, the same shape a player character has. Which is the point: a foothill is where the world is LIVED IN rather than argued from.
⛔ HARDLINE IS THE CLEANEST EXAMPLE OF THE PATTERN: pole + neighbour (method) + ANTIPODE (the thing that makes it sellable). god_named blends authority with falsehood, bargainers blends appetite with truth, hardline blends violence with peace. ⚠️ IN EVERY CASE THE SECOND OR THIRD DOMAIN IS WHAT LETS OTHER PEOPLE DEAL WITH THE FIRST.

harmonic.ratified: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'I agree with you about the Threnodists with the lattice aesthetic for the resonant/harmonic foothill.'
harmonic.why: ⚠️ THRENODIST FOR CRAFT, LATTICE FOR AESTHETIC — the Threnodists sing what they FEEL; the Heights sing what they can BUILD WITH. Sound made structural: standing waves, phononic crystal, interference held as architecture. ⛔ AND LATTICE IS NOT A THRENODIST RING-NEIGHBOUR (pos 15 vs 23), which is fine — the two existing foothills also blend across the ring.
harmonic.note: ⚠️ Sound is not one of the twelve axes. The foothill is where it enters the world.
harmonic._thirdDomain: ⚠️ THIRD DOMAIN ADDED under Erik's three-domain rule. MASON, and the seed argues it: 'buildings GROWN FROM PHONONIC CRYSTAL hum at frequencies you feel in your teeth', and the terraces are cut. ⛔ THRENODIST GIVES SOUND, LATTICE GIVES STRUCTURE, MASON GIVES THE MATERIAL — you cannot hold a standing wave in air alone; something has to be shaped to ring. ⚠️ Erik to confirm mason over numinous, which would make it meaning-in-sound instead.

radiant_folk.ratified: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'Radiant plateau can be light, wright, and order.'
radiant_folk.why:
⛔ LIGHT + MAKING + ORDER, and the crafts show all three. BLAZEBORN gives the medium — Radiance is theirs. WRIGHT gives the turn that makes it usable: Light Well STORES light, Clarity Lens SHAPES it, Beacon Thread STRINGS it between people. LATTICE gives the discipline — light-guides paved into streets and towers that braid sunlight into working beams are an infrastructure, laid out and maintained.
⚠️ THE DIFFERENCE FROM THE PARENT, PLAINLY: A BLAZEBORN SPENDS LIGHT TO EXPOSE SOMETHING AND THE LIGHT IS GONE. THE PLATEAU STORES IT AND SELLS IT. ⛔ That is what makes a foothill an economic centre — the pole performs its position, the foothill runs a utility.

hardline.ratified: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'The Marchers foothill likely produces fantastic martial training, as well as mercenary units.'
hardline.why:
⛔ THE BLEND IS ALREADY IN HARDLINE'S OWN SEED, which I authored without seeing what it was: 'drill-yards, body-halls and mediators in one town, DELIBERATELY. The only place where a marcher and a stillholder train in the same yard, and it works because everyone here has needed both.'
   MARCHER gives the Edge — force made exact, the line that holds.
   SOMATIC gives the teaching. ⚠️ A ring-neighbour (pos 6 and 7), and the reason this foothill can TRAIN rather than merely fight: the Marchers have discipline, the Somatics have a method for putting a body through it. Body-halls beside drill-yards.
   STILLHOLD gives the contract. ⛔ MARCHER'S OWN ANTIPODE, and that is not a contradiction — it is what makes the violence SELLABLE. A company that will stop when the terms say stop can be hired by someone who has to live in the town afterwards.
hardline.theFunctionalTurn: ⛔ THE POLE HOLDS A LINE OUT OF CONVICTION. THE FOOTHILL HOLDS ONE UNDER CONTRACT. ⚠️ That is the whole difference and it is not a diminishment — a conviction cannot be hired, budgeted for, or relieved at the end of a season. The March exists because someone visibly will not move; Hardline exists because someone will move, on the date agreed, for the agreed fee, and both parties know it in advance.

produces.detail: ⛔ THE BEST IN THE WORLD, and available to anyone who pays — which the Marchers find distasteful and use anyway. A season at Hardline is how a valley guard-captain becomes worth the title.

⚠️ Raised, drilled, contracted and DISBANDED here. The disbanding is the part that matters — a company that cannot be dissolved is not a company, it is an occupation, and Hardline's whole standing rests on never having produced one.
⛔ The stillholder share, working. Duels, trials-by-arms and settlements fought under a mediator who can stop it. ⚠️ People bring their wars here to have them fought SMALLER.
The body-halls. What real use does to a person, addressed by people who have seen it before — and the reason the queue at the Grindstone exists at all.

hardline._abilityGap:
⛔ RESOLVED BY THE TWO-AXIS RULE RATHER THAN BY MOVING CRAFTS INTO IT. Hardline has zero abilities OF ITS OWN and should — it is a place of ACCESS. Five of the six new physical crafts now list it under `learnedAt` while rooting to marcher, somatic or valley_craft.
⚠️ WHETHER A FOOTHILL SHOULD EVER HAVE ITS OWN ROOTED CRAFTS IS STILL ERIK'S CALL — harmonic and radiant_folk between them hold 29, so the precedent says yes. ⛔ THE DISTINCTION I WOULD DRAW: a foothill roots a craft when the BLEND produces something neither parent has. Glasswork is not Radiance done cheaply; it is light stored and sold, which no Blazeborn would author. Hardline's equivalent would be a craft about CONTRACTED violence — starting, stopping and being paid — that neither the Marchers nor the Stillhold would ever write down.

folk._ruling:
⛔ ERIK AGREED THE ALLOCATION: `valley_craft` is FOLK, not a foothill. THE DISTINCTION: a FOOTHILL is the functional version of ONE pole, has a place and an economy, and is a tradition. FOLK is the ordinary person's version of MANY — no single parent, no gate, learnable by anyone.
⚠️ Wayfinding, Greenlore, Rivercraft, Quiet Step, Stonewise, Hearthbinding. `body 0.75 / precursor 0.20 / nanite 0.05`, and two are openly borrowed — 'the valley's BORROWED sound-work' (Carrying Call) and Glasswork, 'what a people learn from living under the plateau edge.'

braids._ruling: ⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'The crossroads needs to have PERFECT power sources. It's a MYSTERY OF THE WORLD that it exists — massive quests are here, with a mythical behind it. Likely a BRAID OF PRECURSOR AND VEIL that harmonizes all power sources, such as meta, nanite, etc.'

theCrossing.mechanic: ⛔ UNIVERSAL NEXUS — every power source reads ON-BAND at the Crossing, with no penalty for any.
theCrossing.cause: ⚠️ A STANDING BRAID OF PRECURSOR AND VEIL. Precursor wants density 0.90 and veil wants 0.10 — ⛔ THEY ARE EXACT MIRRORS, and `power_sources.json` already says so: 'the veil is the MIRROR of precursor, because thinning one strengthens the other.' A braid holding both in balance would cancel the density term entirely, which is what 'every axis crosses here at nothing' has always meant.
theCrossing.fiction: ⛔ NOBODY KNOWS WHY IT IS THERE. It is not a built thing anyone will admit to, and the braid holds without a wielder. ⚠️ THAT IS THE MYSTERY AND THE QUEST HOOK: something is sustaining a cross-pole braid at world scale, permanently, and the Crossing is the shadow it casts.
theCrossing.consequence: This is WHY braids cluster here and nowhere else — a braid needs two sources at once, and the Crossing is the only ground that gives both without cost. ⚠️ It also explains the Made Gate: a player built the 27th waygate HERE, and the 26 inherited ones are elsewhere.

notATradition.precursor: ⛔ A POWER SOURCE MISFILED AS A TRADITION. 6 abilities — Address-Sense, Latticespeak, Wake the Line, Unmake Seal, Hold the Aperture, Foreclose. No people owns them; anyone who learns to speak to the lattice has them. ⚠️ Should carry `tradition: null` with `powerSystem: precursor`.

_twoAxes:
⛔ SNG-443, ERIK'S RULING: 'Skills may be learned at PLACES — or in the wilds as a hunter — but they would be TIED BACK TO THEIR TRADITION ROOTS otherwise.'
⚠️ TWO SEPARATE AXES, AND I HAD COLLAPSED THEM:
   `tradition` — THE LINEAGE. Which people's craft this descends from. Permanent, and it is what the power source, the aesthetic and the wheel position all key off.
   `learnedAt` — THE ACCESS. Where a person can actually be taught it: a foothill, a school, a place, or the wilds.
⛔ A FOOTHILL IS A PLACE OF ACCESS, NOT A NEW ANCESTRY. Hardline teaches the Edge; it does not own it. That is exactly what makes a foothill an economic centre — it SELLS ACCESS to something it did not invent, which is also true of the Radiant Plateau selling stored light and the Bargainers selling honest terms.
⚠️ MY ERROR, NAMED: I filed six crafts as `valley_craft` because they were open to anyone, which CONFUSED ACCESS WITH ANCESTRY. Open-to-anyone is a property of the learning, not of the lineage.
